title: Former NLIU VC Prof V Vijayakumar appointed Distinguished Professor at Bengaluru School of Law and Justice
description: The Bengaluru School of Law and Justice (SoLJ) has announced the appointment of Prof V Vijayakumar as Distinguished Professor.Over a career spanning more than four decades, he has served as Professor of Law and Registrar at the National Law School of India University (NLSIU), Bengaluru; Vice-Chancellor of the National Law Institute University (NLIU), Bhopal; and Vice-Chancellor of the Tamil Nadu Dr. Ambedkar Law University, Chennai.
